ArmoryItem.description:
One thing the armory sells. `price` 0 means every profile starts owning it.
A `consumable` (a grenade pack, a pack of special rounds, an armor gem) can be
bought again and again and adds `quantity` grenades, rounds, or gem charges (one
charge reflects one throw or blocks one hit), which get used up in play; a
weapon is bought once. `requires` names an item that must be owned first (the
next weapon tier needs the one before it).
ArmoryItem.title: ArmoryItem

ArmoryLooks.description:
How a kid has dressed up their gear. Every field is optional: unset is the
default look. Each customization needs its style unlock owned (looks_reducers_pure).
ArmoryLooks.title: ArmoryLooks

ArmoryLooksState.description:
The looks, with the URL of every art piece they use, so a game can show one
without loading the whole gallery.
ArmoryLooksState.title: ArmoryLooksState

ArmoryRoundCreate.description:
A finished Zombie Horde round: the points it scored, the grenades it threw, the
special rounds it fired (by bullet item id), the armor gem charges it used (by gem
item id), how long it lasted, and on which difficulty.
ArmoryRoundCreate.title: ArmoryRoundCreate

ArmoryState.description: Everything the armory screen and a round's loadout need, in one response.
ArmoryState.title: ArmoryState

ArtCreate.description: A selfie (a PNG or JPEG data URL) and how to turn it into art.
ArtCreate.title: ArtCreate

ArtPiece.description: One piece made in the art studio, kept in the profile's gallery.
ArtPiece.title: ArtPiece

ArtResult.description: The new piece, and the armory after paying for it.
ArtResult.title: ArtResult

AttemptCreate.description:
Inbound POST body for /api/attempts. Not a table — `Attempt` is the
persisted shape.
AttemptCreate.title: AttemptCreate

BadgeStatus.description:
Response shape for GET /api/profiles/{profile_id}/badges — a Badge
joined with whether (and when) this profile earned it.
BadgeStatus.title: BadgeStatus

BestSurvived.description: The longest round (ms) on each difficulty; 0 before the first.
BestSurvived.title: BestSurvived

DayActivity.description: One local calendar day the profile played.
DayActivity.title: DayActivity

Emblem.description:
A round badge worn on the arm, the blaster, or both: one of the symbols on a
colour, or one of the kid's own art pieces.
Emblem.title: Emblem

GameMetadata.description: Static per-game-module definition — PRD §6. Not a DB table.
GameMetadata.title: GameMetadata

HungPictures.description: Art pieces hung in the games, by art id: Pathfinder's backdrop and Zombie Horde's billboard.
HungPictures.title: HungPictures

IllustrationGenerateRequest.description:
Inbound POST body for /api/pieces/{piece_id}/illustrations/generate —
same shape as IllustrationCreate minus `image_url`, since the server
generates that itself (app/services/image_generation.py).
IllustrationGenerateRequest.title: IllustrationGenerateRequest

NewProfilePhoto.description:
One photo (the camera original or an AI remix of it) to add to a
profile's saved pictures on create/update. Every version a kid made gets
saved, so they can switch back to any of them later; `use_as_avatar`
marks the one to show right now (at most one per request).
NewProfilePhoto.title: NewProfilePhoto

PathfinderCompletionsCreate.description:
Inbound POST body for /api/profiles/{id}/pathfinder/completions.
A list so a bulk import is one request; already-completed ids are
ignored, so re-posting is harmless.
PathfinderCompletionsCreate.title: PathfinderCompletionsCreate

PathfinderCustomMapCreate.description:
Inbound POST body for /api/profiles/{id}/pathfinder/maps. Not a table
— `PathfinderCustomMap` is the persisted shape.
PathfinderCustomMapCreate.title: PathfinderCustomMapCreate

PathfinderCustomMapUpdate.description:
Inbound PATCH body — rename and publish/unpublish. All fields
optional, same pattern as `PieceUpdate`.
PathfinderCustomMapUpdate.title: PathfinderCustomMapUpdate

PieceCreate.description:
Inbound POST body for /api/pieces. Not a table — `Piece` is the
persisted shape.
PieceCreate.title: PieceCreate

PieceUpdate.description:
Inbound PATCH body for /api/pieces/{piece_id} — the revise step edits
title and/or body; both are optional so a caller can send just one.
PieceUpdate.title: PieceUpdate

PracticeConfigUpsert.description:
Inbound PUT body for /api/practice-config. Not a table — `PracticeConfig`
is the persisted shape.
PracticeConfigUpsert.title: PracticeConfigUpsert

ProfileCreate.description:
Inbound POST body for /api/profiles. Not a table — `Profile` is the
persisted shape.
ProfileCreate.title: ProfileCreate

ProfilePhotoRead.description: A saved picture as GET /api/profiles/{id}/photos returns it.
ProfilePhotoRead.title: ProfilePhotoRead

ProfilePhotoRemixRequest.description:
Inbound POST body for /api/profile-photos/remix — a preview only;
nothing is saved until the chosen result comes back on a create/update.
ProfilePhotoRemixRequest.title: ProfilePhotoRemixRequest

ProfileRead.description:
What the API returns for a profile: `Profile` plus whether it's
password-protected. This, not the table row, is the shape the frontend
ever sees.
ProfileRead.title: ProfileRead

ProfileUnlockRequest.description:
Inbound POST body for /api/profiles/{profile_id}/unlock — the
profile's own password, or the admin password as an override.
ProfileUnlockRequest.title: ProfileUnlockRequest

ProfileUpdate.description:
Inbound PATCH body for /api/profiles/{profile_id} (admin-only — see
`app/admin_auth.py`). All fields optional so a caller can send just the
ones changing, same pattern as `PieceUpdate`.
ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate

PublishedPathfinderMap.description:
Outbound row for the Published Maps screen — a published custom map
plus its builder's name, so players can see whose map they're playing.
PublishedPathfinderMap.title: PublishedPathfinderMap

RatingCreate.description:
Inbound POST body for /api/ratings. Not a table — `Rating` is the
persisted shape. `value` is bounded to 1-5 for both scales currently
defined (RatingScale.FACES and .STARS_1_5 are both 5-point scales).
RatingCreate.title: RatingCreate

RemixVersionCreate.description: Inbound POST body for /api/pieces/{piece_id}/remixes — Style Remix Lab only.
RemixVersionCreate.title: RemixVersionCreate

Replay.description: A summary and the full recording.
Replay.title: Replay

RevisionPassCreate.description:
Inbound POST body for /api/pieces/{piece_id}/revisions — recorded once
per coach pass, whether or not the kid actually changed anything (the
illustration gate needs to know `changed`, not just that the step ran).
RevisionPassCreate.title: RevisionPassCreate

SuitPaint.description: A suit painted in the kid's own colour, in place of a skin's tint.
SuitPaint.title: SuitPaint

TelemetryCore.description: The mandatory floor of every Attempt payload — PRD §5.3, §6.
TelemetryCore.title: TelemetryCore

TurnAuthor.description:
Who wrote a given `TurnLine` in the Tag-Team Story game — HANDOFF.md §4.
Tag-Team turns are one line at a time; the kid writes most of them.
TurnAuthor.title: TurnAuthor

TurnLineCreate.description: Inbound POST body for /api/pieces/{piece_id}/turns — Tag-Team Story only.
TurnLineCreate.title: TurnLineCreate

VerificationCreate.description:
Inbound POST body for /api/verifications. Not a table — `Verification`
is the persisted shape.
VerificationCreate.title: VerificationCreate

post.description:
Lets the admin screen check a password before showing itself — a UX
nicety, not the actual gate. `require_admin` (checked per-request on the
admin-only endpoints below) is what actually protects anything; this
endpoint holds no session state of its own.

schema.title: Response List Todos Api Examples Todos Get
Response Replace Todos Api Examples Todos Put

get.description: Backs the Game Picker screen — lists every registered game module.

schema.title: Response List Games Api Games Get

get.description:
Every profile's published maps, newest first. Unpublishing a map just
drops it from this list.

schema.title: Response List Published Pathfinder Maps Api Pathfinder Published Maps Get

get.description:
Backs the Storybook shelf — every piece a kid has saved, optionally
filtered to one game.

schema.title: Response List Pieces Api Pieces Get

delete.description:
Lets a kid pull a finished story off the shelf. Removes the piece's
child rows first since there's no DB-level cascade configured.

patch.description:
The revise step edits `title` and/or `body` — HANDOFF.md §3's illustration
gate (at least one revision change) reads `revised_at`/`word_count` off of this.

schema.title: Response List Illustrations Api Pieces  Piece Id  Illustrations Get

post.description:
Generates the actual art via whichever `ImageGenerator` is configured
(app/services/image_generation.py) and persists it. Falls back to an
empty `image_url` — the frontend's tinted placeholder — if no provider is
configured or generation fails, rather than failing the request.
Style Remix Lab only — one row per style the kid tries on the same piece.

Records one coach pass. `changed` (not just that the pass ran) is what
HANDOFF.md §3's illustration gate cares about.
Tag-Team Story only — appends one line, kid- or AI-authored, to the piece.

delete.description: Reverts this profile/game to the server-adaptive Level.

get.description:
Backs the practice-settings screen (e.g. Equation Outbreak's focus
picker). 404 means "no config yet — this game is on automatic
difficulty," not an error.

put.description:
Creates or replaces the (profile_id, game_id) config — no auth (PRD §2
non-goals): this is a practice preference, not a destructive action, so
it doesn't need the admin screen's password gate.

post.description:
Backs the photo "remix" panel on the create/edit-profile screens: sends
the captured photo plus a preset style and/or the kid's own idea to the
image provider and hands the result straight back for preview. Nothing is
saved here — the versions the kid keeps come back as `new_photos` on the
profile create/update. No auth, same trust model as POST /api/profiles.

get.description:
Read-only listing for the profile-picker screen. No auth (PRD §2 non-goals)
— `has_password` tells the picker which profiles to ask a password for.

schema.title: Response List Profiles Api Profiles Get

post.description:
Backs the create-profile screen. No auth (PRD §2 non-goals) — anyone on
the LAN can add a player, same trust model as everything else here.

delete.description:
Admin-only (see `app/admin_auth.py`) — backs the admin screen's remove
action. Removes every row that hangs off this profile first since
there's no DB-level cascade configured (same reasoning as `delete_piece`).

patch.description:
Backs the edit-profile screen. A password-protected profile needs its
own password (`X-Profile-Password`) or the admin password (either header)
— see `app/services/profile_passwords.py`. A profile with no password is
editable by anyone, same as creating one.

get.description: The balance, owned items, grenades left, and the catalog with prices.

schema.title: Response List Art Api Profiles  Profile Id  Armory Art Get

post.description:
Turns a selfie into art and keeps it. Points are charged only when the art
is made: 409 when they can't be afforded, 503 when the AI isn't available.

get.description: The profile's looks (the default look until first saved), with the URL of each art piece they use.

put.description:
Saves the looks. 409 when one needs an unlock (or skin) that isn't owned, or
uses art that isn't in this profile's gallery.

post.description:
Buys one item. 409 when it's already owned, needs another item first, costs
more than the balance, or is art (made in the art studio instead).
Banks a finished round's points and spends the grenades it threw.

get.description:
Backs the Accomplishments screen's badge shelf — every seeded badge,
annotated with whether (and when) this profile earned it.

schema.title: Response Get Profile Badges Api Profiles  Profile Id  Badges Get

get.description:
Badges this profile earned but hasn't celebrated yet, oldest first.
Cheap enough to poll while the kid plays.

schema.title: Response Get New Badges Api Profiles  Profile Id  Badges New Get

post.description:
Paints this profile's own art for a badge it earned, and waits for it (a
few seconds). The badge comes back with art_status ready, or failed.
The kid has seen this badge's celebration.

get.description: The profile's kept recordings, newest first, without their data.

schema.title: Response List Horde Replays Api Profiles  Profile Id  Horde Replays Get

post.description: Keeps a finished (or left) round's recording; older ones past the last few are dropped.

get.description:
Ids of every curated Pathfinder level this kid has finished — the
level map derives locked/unlocked/completed from these.

schema.title: Response Get Pathfinder Completions Api Profiles  Profile Id  Pathfinder Completions Get

post.description:
Records finished levels. Idempotent: already-recorded ids are skipped,
so a replayed level keeps its original completion time. Returns the full
updated list so the client doesn't need a second round trip.

schema.title: Response Add Pathfinder Completions Api Profiles  Profile Id  Pathfinder Completions Post

get.description: Backs My Maps — most recently created first.

schema.title: Response List Pathfinder Maps Api Profiles  Profile Id  Pathfinder Maps Get

patch.description: Rename and/or publish/unpublish. `id` and `created_at` never change.

get.description:
Backs the edit screen's "Your pictures" strip — every saved photo and
AI remix, oldest first. Same access rule as PATCH.

schema.title: Response List Profile Photos Api Profiles  Profile Id  Photos Get

delete.description:
Removes one saved picture (row and file). 409 for the current profile
picture — switch to another first. Same access rule as PATCH.

get.description:
Backs the Accomplishments screen's parent-facing stats — derived live
from the Rating/Attempt/Event log rather than stored (HANDOFF.md §4).

post.description:
Backs the password prompt shown when a kid picks a protected profile
(or opens its edit screen). Accepts the profile's own password, or the
admin password as an override. A profile with no password always
unlocks. Like `admin_login`, this holds no session state — the frontend
keeps the password and sends it on later edits as `X-Profile-Password`.
